notes.title: Silencer at PlayNYC
notes.content:
[h1]Silencer at PlayNYC![/h1]

We are showing at PlayNYC at the NYU Game Center Incubator booth on
[list]
[*]Saturday (8/23) from 1 pm to 4 pm and
[*]Sunday (8/24) from 10 am to 12:30 pm.
[/list]
Come by, and let's play some games!

[h3]And hush hush...[/h3]
We have tea ready for you.
That's right! As a good employee and upright citizen of Ogalia, you are all entitled to some good tea (bags) and some cool stickers.

See you soon, and long live Ogalia!
